response.sql:
WITH linked AS (
    SELECT s.signalregistry,
           s.modindex,
           s.phaseshiftdeg,
           t.telescregistry,
           o.weathprofile
    FROM signals AS s
    JOIN telescopes AS t
      ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
    JOIN observatories AS o
      ON o.observstation = t.observstation
),
groups AS (
    SELECT telescregistry,
           weathprofile,
           AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex,
           AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshift
    FROM linked
    GROUP BY telescregistry, weathprofile
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM linked
),
kept AS (
    SELECT g.telescregistry,
           g.weathprofile,
           g.avg_modindex,
           g.avg_phaseshift,
           g.avg_modindex - b.avg_modindex AS excess_modindex
    FROM groups AS g
    CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
    WHERE g.avg_modindex > b.avg_modindex
)
SELECT weathprofile,
       AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_kept_group_modindex,
       AVG(avg_phaseshift) AS avg_kept_group_phaseshift,
       AVG(excess_modindex) AS avg_modindex_above_baseline
FROM kept
GROUP BY weathprofile;

assumptions.assumption: SQLite AVG ignores NULL modulation-index values, so the baseline is averaged over linked signals with a non-NULL modulation index; each such signal contributes equally.
